## Description

Refs #5054; part of #5052, after merged #4942. This is the bounded launch-probe correction, not completion of general recovery admission or #5040 policy.

**Current published head:** `7ba8ab387d20685ddd56dc8317babf85b4bc820a`, synchronized with frozen main `ee916d9640b6cf51aadf7f766b3b285fd9a461ff` by a clean normal-hook merge. A failed tmux observation does not prove Agent death. Preserve the runtime and conversation when launch readiness cannot be established.

### Scope

- Capture physical session/pane identity and tmux server process birth at creation. Observe the captured socket and immutable IDs with bounded commands; cached/name-only absence is not death evidence.
- Return a finite `launch_indeterminate` result without generic teardown, poller retirement, false failed-resume marking, input/wake delivery, or successful restart counts. Reservation release is generation-owned; release failure keeps the runtime.
- Revalidate confirmed death before marker/cleanup. Renamed or replaced panes remain protected. Preserve already-published identity and concurrent Status/explicit assertions. A missing PID is accepted only on a confirmed-dead pane with matching immutable ownership; live panes still require the captured PID.
- Handle the outcome through API/Ensure, daemon client, CLI and TUI. Detailed observation errors stay private; callers get finite actionable causes.

The existing later-fresh policy and direct-start distinction are unchanged. #5040 owns the policy cutover. No new settings, persistent schema migration, retry engine, or global action registry.

### Current verification

[Current integrated foundation proof, exact commands and live receipts](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/10bd33cdc5e917dad9da396a533c76df8d183cd2/.github/review-evidence/5052-main-ee916-foundation-fa504071.json). They are not claimed as standalone runs at this S1 head.

Two current real CLI/core-daemon/tmux cases exercise malformed exact-owned observation and an actually stabilizing owned pane. Both return finite `launch_indeterminate`, preserve the probe's newly started native PID/SID/history, create no failed-resume marker or wake/input, then accept the next explicit input on that actor. The earlier process was deliberately replaced by the explicit restart; this is not a claim that its PID survived that request. Cleanup is green.

[Historical standalone S1 verification](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/f528eaa56f8fc1a2a0ec44ce489cd26678f1d42a/.github/review-evidence/5054-S1-main-ec7-5ed141f8.json) remains tied to `5ed141f8` and main ec7. ## Description

Depends on #5058; minimal #4942 is merged. Part of #5052: ordinary request-error ingestion from #5053, matching ACP keepalive from #5054, and diagnostic retention, not full #5055 controls.

**Current published head:** `42ef2d94ca342470afc49d6dddb2d07340458f19`, after synchronized S1 `7ba8ab387d20685ddd56dc8317babf85b4bc820a`, with frozen main `ee916d9640b6cf51aadf7f766b3b285fd9a461ff`. The main-based diff also contains its unmerged predecessor.

A failed `session/prompt` response proves an operation failed, not that the Agent process crashed or its conversation disappeared. The old local path ended the connection; an adopted completion could instead lose the diagnostic and report success.

- [Ordinary local errors](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/src/acp/acp_client/connection/prompt.rs#L312-L381) emit a scrubbed, bounded `PromptRuntimeError`, then one `Stopped("prompt_failed")`. Connection, conversation, history and pending interactions remain available. No failed prompt is replayed.
- [Adopted completion](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/src/acp/acp_client/control.rs#L760-L865) preserves the same diagnostic and terminal ordering. Optional evidence carries provenance, operation, reported code, freshness and worker generation. Unknown origin, runtime state and retryability remain unknown; arbitrary `error.data` is not public metadata.
- [Publication fencing](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/src/acp/supervisor/drain.rs#L170-L260) rejects superseded producers before sequencing, persistence and folding, but permits the exact retained original drain during retirement. The unchanged [Keep-handoff regression](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/src/server/api/acp/view.rs#L2292-L2550) protects its late native SID and verified store.
- [Interaction submission](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/web/src/hooks/useAcpSession.ts#L123-L166) now rejects failed approval requests to the card, allowing explicit retry. HTTP failure is not relabelled as network failure. Destructive approvals still require a fresh complete hold.
- A transient interaction error does not replace the canonical operation diagnostic. Matching resolution reveals the original diagnostic; reload preserves it; accepted explicit input retires the active banner. [Consumer regression](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/web/src/components/acp/__tests__/SessionBanners.test.tsx#L68-L270).

The [producer/consumer contract](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/98bce215def1bc0d1dfc55d1cad4b2be6a986a84/docs/development/internals/structured-view.md#L29-L130) documents the boundaries. Existing rate-limit parking, stored-session rejection and transport-closure policy remain separate. This is not the remaining Terminal/common-admission fix, explicit fresh/retry policy, or full recovery UI.

### Current verification and limits

[Current integrated foundation proof](https://github.com/jerome-benoit/agent-of-empires/blob/10bd33cdc5e917dad9da396a533c76df8d183cd2/.github/review-evidence/5052-main-ee916-foundation-fa504071.json) records the complete default Rust and frontend matrices plus actual CLI/core/tmux scenarios at S3 `fa5040711b62f9638b2d45aa8c7769cee2983972`, which includes this cut. No standalone full-matrix run at the new S2 head is claimed. Source links in the behaviour bullets pin the original implementation; the current isolated review boundary above pins this merge.

This is not A's later native-channel authority, quota/constructor/fork-custody work, B retirement, C retained establishment, #5040 or full #5055 policy. issue.title: Epic: separate Agent operation errors from runtime failure and recovery
issue.body:
## Problem and evidence boundary

The reporter describes OMP displaying a provider CONNECTION error while its process, Session and Agent conversation remained usable. This is not a reported process crash. The exact original TUI transition that requested recovery is not established; do not invent it.

OMP can report Error from a provider banner without process death ([src/tmux/detect/manifests/omp.toml:223-250](https://github.com/agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires/blob/3dee713c3136a403961b1d71c22288a457b57dab/src/tmux/detect/manifests/omp.toml#L223-L250)). Current terminal Ensure checks pane readiness, not Error alone. ACP request errors and uncertain tmux observations still have different lifecycle consequences. We need explicit evidence and action boundaries, not another blanket retry.

## Immediate scope

#4941 / #4942 protect managed conversation identity: constrain native resume to the original context or refuse, preserving the recorded identity. Native cross-project lookup was demonstrated with OMP only. This does not prove the full live-provider-error flow fixed, and #4942 still retains the baseline later-fresh policy. #5041 is a draft for the distinct policy in #5040, not an approved universal recovery fix.

Prioritize the bounded unknown-probe correction in the recovery-admission ticket; it must not wait for a broad error-model refactor.

## Proposed contract

- Keep runtime liveness, observed activity Status, operation failure, blocking scope, recoverability and conversation identity independent. A live process can have a blocked request; an exited process can leave a valid conversation.
- Error display alone never authorizes kill, relaunch, identity clearing, fresh conversation or prompt replay. Unknown observations remain unknown.
- Agent-owned provider retries stay agent-owned. Existing explicitly enabled AoE policies remain governed by their documented constraints; do not create a competing retry engine.
- A confirmed exit may enable an authorized restart of the same attested conversation. The target fresh-conversation contract requires explicit user intent, never an inference from an error. This is a proposed policy tracked in #5040, not the baseline currently retained by #4942; approve it before changing behavior.
- Preserve ownership, lifecycle generations, capture, CAS and namespace checks. Same-ID replay/qualification must not erase a durable failed-resume marker. Share server decisions across clients, not independent client heuristics.

## Tracked work and order

- [ ] #5054: bounded uncertain-probe non-destruction first; broader admission consumes #5053's evidence contract.
- [ ] #5053: orthogonal operation/runtime evidence, ACP ingestion and retained-conversation authority, coordinated with #5054.
- [ ] #5040: explicit Same/Fresh recovery after a qualified failed probe; #5041 remains reference-only.
- [ ] #5055: consistent diagnostics and authorized controls after the native and terminal contracts.
- [ ] #5181: isolated preexisting transcript bootstrap defect for tools opened before browser attachment. Native sub-issue, assigned to the epic driver.

No broad identity or supervisor rewrite is a prerequisite for the fast-track fix. These are proposed work items requiring triage, not claims of completed implementation.

## Completion
